title: Elytra Softlock
description: A Minecraft challenge mod for survival servers and singeplayer.
body:
# ❓ What is Elytra Softlock?

**Elytra Softlock** is a Minecraft challenge mod where *the ground is your enemy—and touching it means instant death.*

You are forced into permanent flight from the moment you spawn, turning every movement into a high-stakes aerial puzzle.

---

## 🎮 Core Concept

This mod completely reshapes survival gameplay:

* Touching the ground **instantly kills you**
* You must stay airborne at all times
* Movement becomes a constant flight challenge instead of traditional survival

---

## 🪂 Starting Conditions

Every new world begins with a controlled “softlock” setup:

* 🪽 You spawn with an **Elytra**
* 🎆 You receive **15 Fireworks**
* ⬆️ You spawn **25 blocks above the normal spawn point**

From the very first second, you’re already in the air—and already under pressure.

---

## ⚡ Gameplay Loop

Instead of mining, walking, or building normally, players must:

* Chain Elytra flight and firework boosts
* Plan safe landing avoidance routes
* Navigate terrain without ever touching it
* Survive longer by mastering aerial control

One mistake is enough to end your run.

---

## 💀 Challenge Focus

Elytra Softlock is designed for:

* Hardcore challenge runs
* Speedrunning-style attempts
* Skill-based aerial movement gameplay
* Chaos survival scenarios with friends

---

## 🧠 Tips (If You Want to Survive Longer)

* Don’t waste fireworks early—control is everything
* Gain height before attempting long travel distances
* Use terrain as a guide, not a landing option
* Always assume you are one mistake away from death

---

## 🧩 Summary

Elytra Softlock transforms Minecraft into a pure aerial survival challenge where:

> **the ground is lava, and gravity is your enemy.**

Good luck staying airborne.
